items.name: Millau Viaduct
items.caption: Crews launched the steel deck from both sides of the Tarn valley.
items.detail: Temporary steel piers shortened the spans during launching. The two halves met above the Tarn in May 2004.
items.image_alt: Illustration of Millau Viaduct’s steel deck advancing across the Tarn valley on temporary supports

items.name: Sydney Opera House
items.caption: The roof shells share the geometry of a single sphere.
items.detail: The common geometry let crews cast standardized concrete rib segments on site and lift them into place. The Opera House opened in 1973.
items.image_alt: Artistic reconstruction of the Sydney Opera House roof under construction, with exposed concrete ribs above the harbour.
